summary: Repository upkeep with no user-visible change: CI scope, secret scan, dependabot, knip, coverage script, contributor docs; the desktop and the Expo app build fork requests through one shared function (buildForkConversationRequest); dead shims removed (claude-adapter policy re-exports, a stale close-focus branch, terminal-store globalActivePaneId); bookmark ids use crypto.randomUUID instead of nanoid.

nativeAndroid.reason: Android builds its own fork request in Kotlin; the wire contract is unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: Nothing stored changes; new bookmark ids are still unique strings.

automated: Full vitest suite (6,032 tests) including ci-scope, conversation-fork-contract and the updated store and close-focus tests; typecheck.
notExercised: The CI scope skip is exercised on the first docs-only PR after merge.
